features.name: sum_all_features
features.description: Linear sum across all 10 input features; provides a simple linear projection useful as an SVM margin baseline.
features.expected_model_benefit: Directly aligns with linear hyperplane structure in input space.

features.name: x1_weighted_sum_rest
features.description: x1 multiplied by the sum of the other features, encoding interaction between the highest-variance feature and the rest.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures multiplicative structure that linear SVM cannot capture from raw features alone.

features.name: x1_sign_times_magnitude_sum
features.description: Sign of x1 multiplied by sum of absolute values of the other features; smooth severity-like score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a directional severity composite for linear margin separation.
features.formula: np.where(x1 >= 0, 1.0, -1.0) * (np.abs(x2) + np.abs(x3) + np.abs(x4) + np.abs(x5) + np.abs(x6) + np.abs(x7) + np.abs(x8) + np.abs(x9) + np.abs(x10))

features.name: abs_x1
features.description: Magnitude of x1; continuous severity measure for the most variable input.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows linear SVM to learn nonlinear relationship between x1 magnitude and outcome.

features.name: mean_abs_features
features.description: Average magnitude across all input features; smooth normalized aggregate.
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous summary that complements signed linear combinations.
features.formula: (np.abs(x1) + np.abs(x2) + np.abs(x3) + np.abs(x4) + np.abs(x5) + np.abs(x6) + np.abs(x7) + np.abs(x8) + np.abs(x9) + np.abs(x10)) / 10.0

features.name: positive_feature_count_norm
features.description: Fraction of features with positive value across the 10 inputs.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the directional balance of features as a normalized linear-friendly score.

features.name: x1_x2_product
features.description: Pairwise interaction between x1 and x2.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds explicit nonlinear interaction lift to a linear SVM.

features.name: x1_x3_product
features.description: Pairwise interaction between x1 and x3.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds another explicit nonlinear interaction term for SVM separation.

features.name: sqrt_sumsq_features
features.description: Euclidean norm of the 10-dimensional row vector; smooth global magnitude.
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous norm useful as a margin-scaling auxiliary feature.

features.name: x1_sq_minus_rest_sq_mean
features.description: Squared x1 minus average of squared other features; contrast in variance contribution.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights when x1 dominates row variance, useful for linear separation boundaries.

features.name: signed_x1_x2_x3_composite
features.description: Smooth weighted composite emphasizing the top three columns with decreasing weights.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a hand-weighted linear projection focused on lower-index features.

features.name: feature_dispersion_judgment
features.description: Semantic judgment of how dispersed the row values are: ratio of max absolute feature value to mean absolute feature value, capped, indicating whether the row is dominated by a single feature versus broadly distributed.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps linear SVM separate concentrated-signal rows from diffuse-signal rows.
